description: The open and fulfilled VAT obligations HMRC holds for one VRN, or for one practice client's VRN when clientId is given instead of vrn, over the deployed API. Uses the session's HMRC authorisation: call request_hmrc_authorisation first if this tool says none is held.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to resolve vrn from the client row instead

from.description: From date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the start of the current calendar year

hmrcAccount.description: Which HMRC environment to call; defaults to the session's HMRC authorisation's own

status.description: O (Open) or F (Fulfilled); both when omitted

to.description: To date, YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today

vrn.description: VAT registration number, 9 digits; required unless clientId is given

name: list_vat_obligations
title: List VAT obligations
